comment: 48yo male with three concurrent IARC Group 1 / WCRF cancer-etiology RedFlags: (1) chronic HCV (HCV-RNA detectable, untreated, no current B-cell NHL) → fires RF-CHRONIC-HCV-NHL-PREVENTION-OPPORTUNITY; (2) current smoker, 25 pack-years → fires RF-LIFESTYLE-TOBACCO-CANCER-PREVENTION; (3) BMI 35 (class 2 obesity) → fires RF-LIFESTYLE-OBESITY-CANCER-PREVENTION. No current malignancy. Engine should aggregate into multi-track PreventionPlan: (a) DAA antiviral therapy (HCV cure → reduced NHL + HCC) + (b) 5A structured tobacco cessation + varenicline + LDCT lung screening + (c) structured behavioral weight-loss + GLP-1 RA + BMI-elevated cancer screening (HCC surveillance especially relevant given HCV+obesity HCC convergence); alternative = behavioral counseling + symptom-triggered evaluation. Validates v0.2-A / v0.3 multi-RedFlag aggregation pathway.
